global_drops.name: lib/misc/socials
global_drops.reason: legacy old-format social file; `CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS` is YES, so the run-time reads `lib/misc/socials.new` (issue #17)

global_drops.name: lib/text/credits
global_drops.reason: the credit text is served by the engine's `credits` command from the pack's hand-authored `stdlib.credits` section (MIB #22), not as a help topic: a topic id equal to a command name is unreachable

global_drops.name: lib/text/help
global_drops.reason: legacy `help.hlp` database; the generated command catalog plus the converted `lib/text` and `lib/misc/messages` topics supersede it, except its `CIRCLEMUD` entry, which is preserved as the `circlemud` topic for the CircleMUD licence (issue #18)

global_drops.name: $i
global_drops.reason: tbaMUD `perform_act` has no `$i` case; the code is preserved in `tba.socials` and expands to nothing at run time

unmapped.name: east
unmapped.detail:
In the east you see an arm of the dominating mountain range on this
continent, the White Mountains.  Though not as high as those in the
north, the sight of those mountains fills you with awe.

unmapped.name: north
unmapped.detail:
To the north, the tall White Mountains have their highest peaks.
The mountaintops disappear in the white clouds, far above the
plains.  The sight of those high, far mountains fills you with a
desire to scale them, to see the world from that vantage.

unmapped.name: south
unmapped.detail: To the south, rolling hills stretch away, as far as you can see.

unmapped.name: west
unmapped.detail:
As you look west, you see a river flowing through all of Midgaard
and continuing beyond it towards a great lake.  Still further
away, you can glimpse something silvery that has to be the Sea.

unmapped.name: up
unmapped.detail:
You cannot see the sky above since the trees around the stone ring
block it out entirely.
